items.summary: The National Statistics Office (NSO), Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI), Government of India, has prepared the draft guideline for Compilation of Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) Estimates from Expenditure Side with Base Year 2022-23. The guideline is being released and uploaded on the official website of MoSPI (link attached below).
items.title: Release of Draft Guideline for Compilation Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) Estimates by Expenditure Approach with Base Year 2022-23

items.summary: ASEAN hosted the 15th AITIGA Joint Committee and related meetings to review the progress and negotiations of the ASEAN-India Trade in Goods Agreement (AITIGA) at the ASEAN Secretariat, Jakarta, Indonesia, during 6 th to 9 th October 2026 along with other sub-committee meetings. The event was conducted in a hybrid format. The meeting was co-chaired by Shri Nitin Kumar Yadav, Additional…
items.title: 15th Meeting of ASEAN-India Trade in Goods Agreement (AITIGA) Joint Committee held during 6-9 October 2026
